Package com.hkust.marketplace.testcase

Class AdminPortalTest

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.testcase.AdminPortalTest
@DisplayName("Task 3: Admin Portal Functionality Test Suite") public class AdminPortalTest extends Object
Automated JUnit 5 Integration and Functional Test Suite for Task 3: Admin Portal.

File Placement: HKUST-Marketplace/src/test/java/com/hkust/marketplace/testcase/AdminPortalTest.java

How to Execute:

  1. Ensure MySQL 8 is running and hkust_marketplace is initialized using src/main/resources/db/schema.sql.
  2. Configure DB credentials via environment variables MARKETPLACE_DB_USER and MARKETPLACE_DB_PASSWORD, or ~/.hkust-marketplace/database.properties.
  3. Ensure JDK 21 is active (matches pom.xml maven.compiler.release=21).
  4. Run:
    • Windows PowerShell: .\mvnw.cmd test -Dtest=com.hkust.marketplace.testcase.AdminPortalTest
    • macOS / Linux: ./mvnw test -Dtest=com.hkust.marketplace.testcase.AdminPortalTest

Database Isolation and Cleanup: Every test generates a unique random prefix (e.g. t9f3a2c1b_) for all users, listings, deals, reviews, chat threads, and notifications it creates, and removes them in tearDown() in foreign-key-safe order. Seeded demo accounts (admin, alice, bob, charlie, diana) are never modified.

Task 3 Coverage Map:

  • Task 3.1 Admin Login -> AdminPortalTest.Task31_AdminLoginTests
  • Task 3.2 Listing Review and Approval -> AdminPortalTest.Task32_ListingReviewTests
  • Task 3.3 Manage All Users -> AdminPortalTest.Task33_ManageUsersTests
  • Task 3.4 Manage Own Profile -> AdminPortalTest.Task34_ManageOwnProfileTests
  • Task 3.5 All Deals Record -> AdminPortalTest.Task35_AllDealsRecordTests
  • Task 3.6 Notification Board -> AdminPortalTest.Task36_NotificationBoardTests
  • Task 3.7 Manage All Listings -> AdminPortalTest.Task37_ManageAllListingsTests
  • Task 3.8 Seller Ratings Overview -> AdminPortalTest.Task38_SellerRatingsOverviewTests
  • Additional TODO coverage -> AdminPortalTest.Task3CoverageGapTests

Manual JavaFX UI Checklist (visual/dialog behavior not executed by headless JUnit):

  • AdminLoginView.fxml: verify there is no registration button or link.
  • Listing Review: verify 140x105 photo thumbnails, Approve confirmation, and Rejection Reason dialog.
  • Manage Users: verify Delete confirmation dialog; check whether Deactivate needs confirmation.
  • Manage All Listings: verify type-first form gating, photo chooser (max 6 / 16 MiB), and Edit/Remove dialogs.
  • Seller Ratings: verify the two-row filter bar and the enabled Hide/Unhide round-trip on hidden reviews.
